objects.description: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) has developed malware for their operations, including ransomware such as [BitPaymer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0570) and [WastedLocker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0612).(Citation: Crowdstrike Indrik November 2018)
objects.description_fa: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) بدافزاری را برای عملیات خود ایجاد کرده است، از جمله باج‌افزارهایی مانند [BitPaymer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0570) و [WastedLocker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0612).[[ERVE_0]] (Citation: Crowdstrike Indrik November 2018)
